summary.text: Paul Torkelson is a Republican who represents District 15B in the Minnesota House of Representatives and was first elected in 2008.

His official House page identifies him as Assistant Republican Leader, lists a Ways and Means committee assignment, and gives his occupation as farmer, with a B.A. in education from Gustavus Adolphus College.

sources.title: Rep. Paul Torkelson (15B) - Minnesota House of Representatives
